name: Become a Lifeguard and Swim Instructor at NVRC
org: North Vancouver Recreation and Culture Commission
what_you_do: Take the courses in order. They are Bronze Medallion, Bronze Cross, First Aid, National Lifeguard Pool and Swim Instructor. Then apply online for pool jobs with NVRC.
who_can_apply: Age minimums by course. Bronze Medallion is 13. First Aid is 15. National Lifeguard is 15. Swim Instructor is 15. Lifesaving Instructor is 16. To apply for a job, you must be a citizen, a permanent resident or have a valid work permit.
pay_detail: Course fees not stated on the pages read. Job pay not stated.
how_to_apply: Sign up for courses online. After you are certified, apply on the NVRC job site. Email swim@nvrc.ca with questions.
notes: Courses need 100% attendance. Withdraw 8 or more days before the start for a full refund. The minimum age to be hired is not stated on the pages read.
